_comment: EDITABLE DATA, not code. VERIFIED 14 Aug 2026 against the real operator timetable supplied by Orathai (เรือไปเกาะช้าง - ท่าเรืออ่าวธรรมชาติ / Ao Thammachat, updated April 2026). Ao Thammachat is the ONLY pier in use (Orathai confirmed) - single crossing point, no multi-pier logic. Queue baselines remain only for the shadow queue-learning drift comparison; live readers use pre_boarding_min.

sailings._note: Actual departure list, identical both directions (Trat <-> Koh Chang). Next sailing = LIST LOOKUP, never interval math. Published list is a conservative FLOOR - the operator runs unpublished extra boats in peak; do NOT model them (warning early is the correct bias for an alert system). Timetable caveat: rounds may change with weather - FEASIBLE/AT-RISK wording must say 'ตามตารางปกติ'; only IMPOSSIBLE may be stated firmly.

_pre_boarding_note: Operator instruction: 'ควรมาก่อนเวลาเรือออกอย่างน้อย 45 นาที'. Ticket office opens 05:30, CASH ONLY, no scan/transfer, counter queue - no pre-purchase. The 06:30 sailing requires being at the pier by ~05:45. Replaces the old ~15 min queue estimate (a 30-min under-estimate, large enough to flip verdicts).
_crossing_note: NOT printed on the operator timetable - unverified estimate; revisit once real GPS trails give an observed figure.
